items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: And I went the next day, and he -- Ludwig said, 'Oh, yeah, you're Gus Johnson, we've been looking for you.

ctx.x: He came by and said, 'How would you like a new set of drums?' I said, 'Fine.' So he said, 'Well, go to Ludwig and tell him I sent you over there.'
